destination.name: Junee
destination.tagline: A railway junction town with a working roundhouse and a licorice factory.
destination.description: Junee is a railway junction town on the line between Sydney and Melbourne and on the Sydney–Griffith line. Its Roundhouse Museum, opened in 1947, is half museum and half locomotive workshop, and the Licorice and Chocolate Factory occupies the old flour mill and draws a crowd. North of town, the Bethungra Spiral is Australia's only 360-degree rail spiral, viewed from a platform above the tunnel.
whyVisit: Tour Junee's licorice and chocolate factory
See the Bethungra Spiral rail loop

goodToKnow.title: Roundhouse days
goodToKnow.detail: Junee Roundhouse Museum is open Wed–Sun 10 am–4 pm with last admission 3:30 pm; entry is about $15.

goodToKnow.title: Factory visits
goodToKnow.detail: The factory is free and open daily 9 am–4 pm except Anzac Day, and chocolate and licorice making can be watched on weekdays.

goodToKnow.title: Train services are few
goodToKnow.detail: Around two services each way most days stop at Junee, so a car is the practical way to reach Bethungra Spiral.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} avoid hot, dry summers that have reached 46 °C and cool, cloudy winters.
